mergedParams.userDescription: Parallax effect: text moving slower than the background video. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Parallax Typokinetics: Text Over Video Motion Effects

prompts.prompt: Create a classic parallax typokinetic preset where text floats above a background video with differential motion speeds, mimicking depth layers in video editing. The text should move at 30-50% of the background video's perceived motion speed. Implement word-by-word reveals synchronized with caption timing data, where each word slides up from below with a subtle elastic bounce. Words should have staggered entrance timing based on their position in the sentence. Higher impact words (from caption metadata) should move even slower, creating additional depth. Add a subtle text shadow that shifts independently, creating a pseudo-3D effect. The background video should have a slight zoom-in effect (scale from 1.0 to 1.1) while the text counter-moves to enhance the parallax illusion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' containing VideoAtom as background layer with 'absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover' and BaseLayout overlay with 'absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none'. Text container uses 'flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 px-8'. Each word wrapped in BaseLayout with 'inline-block' for individual animation control. Effects: Background video uses generic effect with scale 1.0→1.1 over full duration with ease-out. Text container uses translateY effect moving opposite to video scale (0→-10%). Individual words use translateY 100%→0% with spring easing, opacity 0→1, staggered by word index * 0.05s relative timing. High impact words get additional scale effect 0.8→1.0. Text shadow uses separate translateX/Y effects offset by 2-3px from main text movement. Performance: Use transform and opacity only, add 'will-change-transform' to text container. FitDurationTo: 'media' to match video length.

prompts.prompt: Design a multi-layer parallax typography preset inspired by motion graphics title sequences. Create three distinct text layers moving at different speeds: foreground titles (fastest), mid-ground subtitles (medium), and background contextual text (slowest). Each layer should respond to the video's movement inversely - as video pans right, text layers pan left at varying rates. Implement character-level animation for the foreground layer where letters cascade in with rotation and scale. Use caption data to trigger word emphasis through brief scale pulses and glow effects. Background video should have a subtle blur effect that increases towards the edges, enhancing depth perception. Add particle-like decorative text elements that float across the screen at various speeds.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout root with 'relative w-full h-full' containing VideoAtom with blur filter gradient via CSS mask. Three text layers as BaseLayout components with z-index ordering: bg-text 'absolute inset-0 opacity-30', mid-text 'absolute inset-x-0 top-1/3', fg-text 'absolute inset-x-0 bottom-1/4'. Each uses 'flex flex-col items-center'. Effects: Video gets custom filter effect with blur 0→2px radial gradient. Foreground text uses letterSpacing animation synchronized with translateX -5%→5%. Mid-ground translateX -3%→3%, background translateX -1%→1%, all with ease-in-out. Character animations on fg-text use internal effect preset 'character-cascade' with rotate -180→0, scale 0→1, staggered by char index. Keyword-triggered pulses use waveform effect tied to audio beats if available. Particle text elements as absolutely positioned TextAtoms with random translateX/Y paths. Timing: All movements use fitDurationTo: 'parent' with continuous looping via modulo calculations.

prompts.prompt: Develop a perspective-based parallax preset where text appears to exist in 3D space behind and in front of the video subject. Text should slide horizontally while the video remains static, creating an illusion of camera movement through text layers. Implement smart word wrapping that respects the parallax depth - longer words appear further back and move slower. Use caption sentiment data to influence text color temperature (positive=warm, negative=cool). Add motion blur to fast-moving foreground text and depth of field blur to distant text. Create 'text shadows' that are actually duplicated text layers with different parallax speeds, simulating volumetric text.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with perspective CSS property '1000px' via containerProps.style. VideoAtom centered with 'absolute inset-0 m-auto w-4/5 h-4/5 object-contain'. Multiple text layers using transform: translateZ() for true 3D positioning. Foreground text at translateZ(200px), mid at translateZ(0), background at translateZ(-200px). Each word wrapped in BaseLayout with calculated translateZ based on word.length. Effects: Continuous translateX animation from -100% to 100% screen width, speed inversely proportional to Z-depth. Motion blur via SVG filter on fast layers (blur increases with speed). Sentiment-based color via dynamic backgroundColor rgba values. Shadow layers are duplicated TextAtoms with translateZ offset by -50px, opacity 0.3. Use transform3d and backface-visibility: hidden for GPU acceleration. Caption timing drives word appearance with staggered fade-ins. Internal effect preset 'parallax-slide' handles the continuous motion with different speeds per layer.

prompts.prompt: Create a kinetic typography preset with reactive parallax where text movement responds to audio intensity. Background video moves subtly while text layers dance and pulse to the beat. Implement 'floating' text behavior where words drift up and down like they're underwater, with speed influenced by audio frequency data. High-frequency sounds make text jitter quickly, low frequencies create slow, sweeping movements. Words should cluster and separate based on semantic relationships in caption data. Add light leak effects and chromatic aberration to text during intense audio moments. Background video should have a complementary shake effect that's inverse to text movement.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with VideoAtom using 'absolute inset-0' plus BaseLayout text overlay. Text container uses 'relative w-full h-full' with words positioned absolutely based on semantic clustering algorithm. Each word in BaseLayout with 'absolute' positioning and calculated top/left values. Effects: Waveform effects on text for audio reactivity - translateY tied to bass (sensitivity: 0.8), translateX to treble (sensitivity: 0.5), scale to mid frequencies. Floating animation via combined sine wave translateY using generic effects with custom timing functions. Chromatic aberration via CSS filters and text-shadow with red/blue offsets triggered by intensity > 0.7. Video shake effect uses inverse waveform values (when text goes up, video goes down). Light leaks as semi-transparent absolutely positioned divs with 'bg-gradient-to-br from-yellow-200/20 to-transparent' animated via opacity. Use audio analysis API for beat detection and frequency data. FitDurationTo: 'audio' to sync with soundtrack.

prompts.prompt: Design a split-screen parallax typography system where the screen is divided into multiple panels, each with different parallax speeds and text content. Create a 'sliding panels' effect where video and text layers slide past each other like parallax scrolling websites. Implement text that 'sticks' to certain panels while other text flows freely between them. Use caption keywords to trigger panel highlighting and focus effects. Add glass morphism effects to panel borders with backdrop blur. Text should cast dynamic shadows that change angle based on its position relative to panel edges, simulating a moving light source.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Grid layout with 'grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-0 w-full h-full'. Each panel is BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden'. Video spans full background with 'col-span-full row-span-full' placement. Panels contain text with 'sticky' positioning via 'absolute top-0' with calculated transforms. Effects: Panel sliding via translateX with different speeds: panel1 at 1x, panel2 at 0.7x, panel3 at 0.4x. Sticky text uses position absolute with top/left calculations that update based on scroll position simulation. Glass morphism via 'backdrop-blur-md bg-white/10 border border-white/20' on panel overlays. Dynamic shadows calculated using transform matrix for text-shadow property based on element position. Keyword triggers use internal effect preset 'panel-highlight' with scale and glow. Light source angle calculated as atan2 from center, updating text-shadow direction. Performance: Use transform only for animations, CSS containment on panels.

prompts.prompt: Build a z-axis parallax preset where text appears to zoom past the viewer while the video recedes into the distance. Create a 'Star Wars opening crawl' inspired effect but with modern kinetic typography. Words should start large in the foreground and shrink as they move up and back in 3D space. Implement variable speed based on caption timing - important words slow down when centered for emphasis. Add motion streaks and speed lines to enhance the sensation of movement. Background video should slowly zoom out with a complementary barrel distortion effect. Include reactive glow trails that follow moving text.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with CSS perspective: 400px and perspective-origin: 50% 100%. VideoAtom with 'absolute inset-0' and transform-style: preserve-3d. Text container with 'absolute bottom-0 w-full' and rotateX(-25deg) for crawl angle. Words in individual BaseLayouts with 'block w-full text-center'. Effects: Text uses translateY from 150% to -200% and translateZ from 100px to -500px simultaneously. Scale from 2.0 to 0.3 following Z-position. Important words (high impact) get slowdown effect via timing-function manipulation at center point. Motion streaks via box-shadow with multiple offsets: '0 2px 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.5)' repeated with increasing Y values. Video zoom via scale 1.0 to 0.7 with barrel distortion using CSS filter url(#barrel-distortion) with SVG filter. Glow trails as ::after pseudo-elements with animated gradient backgrounds. Speed lines as absolutely positioned thin divs with 'h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white to-transparent' animated along Y axis.

prompts.prompt: Create an orbital parallax preset where text rotates around the video content in elliptical paths at different radii and speeds. Implement physics-based motion where words have momentum and can 'slingshot' around the video. Use caption data to create word constellations that maintain relative positions while orbiting. Add particle effects that trail behind moving text like comet tails. Video should counter-rotate slowly to enhance the relative motion. Implement depth-based blur where text further from the 'camera' becomes progressively out of focus. Create gravitational clustering where semantically related words are attracted to each other.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full' containing centered VideoAtom at 50% scale. Text elements positioned absolutely with calculated orbital paths. Each word in BaseLayout with 'absolute' and transform-origin set to video center. Effects: Orbital motion via combined rotateZ and translateX/Y using parametric equations (x = a*cos(t), y = b*sin(t)). Different orbital speeds via animation-duration: calc(var(--orbit-base) * var(--speed-factor)). Video counter-rotation at -0.1x speed of fastest orbit. Comet tails via multiple box-shadows with decreasing opacity: '2px 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,0.6)' etc. Depth blur using filter: blur() calculated from orbital radius. Gravitational clustering via custom physics calculations in presetExecution, updating translateX/Y offsets. Particle effects as small absolutely positioned divs with 'w-1 h-1 bg-white rounded-full' following delayed orbital paths. Momentum effects via cubic-bezier timing with overshoot. Use requestAnimationFrame simulation for smooth physics.

prompts.prompt: Develop a liquid parallax typography preset where text behaves like it's floating in liquid layers of different densities. Create undulating wave motions where words bob up and down with different phases and amplitudes. Implement refraction effects where text appears distorted when passing behind 'liquid' layers. Use caption timing to create ripple effects that propagate through the text field. Add caustic light patterns that dance across the text. Background video should have a complementary underwater distortion effect. Include bubble particles that rise through the text layers at different speeds based on size.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Multiple BaseLayout layers with 'absolute inset-0' representing liquid densities. VideoAtom with wave distortion filter. Text distributed across layers based on word weight/importance. Each word in BaseLayout with 'inline-block' for individual floating animation. Effects: Sine wave translateY animations with phase offset: sin(t + index * 0.5). Amplitude varies by layer depth: foreground ±20px, background ±5px. Refraction via SVG displacement map filter on middle layers. Ripple effects triggered by new words using radial scale animation propagating outward. Caustic lighting via animated SVG filter with turbulence and lighting effects. Video distortion using feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap. Bubbles as absolutely positioned divs with 'rounded-full bg-white/20' using translateY -100% animation with size-based duration. Float physics via combined sine waves for natural movement: translateX: 10px * sin(t * 0.5), translateY: -speed * t + 15px * sin(t * 0.7). Use blend-mode: screen for light effects.

prompts.prompt: Design a temporal parallax preset where text from different time periods (past, present, future captions) moves at different speeds creating a time-shift effect. Implement 'echo' effects where previous words leave ghostly trails. Current words are sharp and prominent while past words fade and future words are blurred. Create a temporal scrubbing effect where dragging through time causes parallax layers to slide at different rates. Use caption metadata to color-code temporal relationships. Add clock-like radial wipe transitions between temporal states. Background video should play at variable speed based on the temporal focus.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Three temporal layers as BaseLayout divs: past 'absolute inset-0 opacity-50', present 'absolute inset-0', future 'absolute inset-0 opacity-30'. Caption data split by timing into temporal arrays. Each word wrapped with temporal class markers. Effects: Past words use translateX: -30% baseline with blur(2px) and sepia filter. Present words at translateX: 0% with no filters. Future words at translateX: 30% with blur(3px) and brightness(1.5). Temporal sliding via different animation speeds: past at 0.5x, present at 1x, future at 1.5x. Echo trails via cloned elements with decreasing opacity and increasing translateX offset. Radial wipe using clip-path: circle() animation from 0% to 100%. Video playbackRate modulated between 0.5 and 2.0 based on temporal focus. Ghost trails as ::before/::after with 'absolute -z-10' and animated opacity/transform. Color coding via CSS custom properties: --temporal-hue: calc(var(--time-offset) * 60). Clock wipe transition using conic-gradient mask.

prompts.prompt: Create a responsive parallax typography preset that adapts to video motion detection. Implement optical flow analysis where text moves in response to detected motion vectors in the video. Text should 'avoid' moving subjects and cluster in static areas. Create magnetic repulsion effects where high-motion areas push text away. Use caption importance to determine text resistance to motion forces. Add turbulence effects in high-motion zones making text shimmer and vibrate. Background video brightness should influence text contrast dynamically. Include motion trails that visualize the flow field affecting the text.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' containing VideoAtom and motion detection overlay. Text elements positioned absolutely with physics-based positioning. Motion vector field calculated in presetExecution and stored as CSS variables. Each word in BaseLayout with 'absolute' and data-attributes for physics properties. Effects: Motion avoidance via translateX/Y calculated from nearby motion vectors using inverse square law. Repulsion force: F = k/r² where k is based on motion intensity. Text resistance based on importance: high impact words have mass = 2.0, others = 1.0. Turbulence via small random translateX/Y and rotate oscillations when in motion zones. Brightness adaptation using CSS filter: contrast() and brightness() based on video luminosity. Motion trails as Canvas element or SVG paths showing vector field. Shimmer effect via text-shadow animation with random offsets. Use transform3d for all movements, requestAnimationFrame for physics calculations. Motion detection via frame differencing or optical flow library. Store motion field in CSS custom properties for reactive styling.
